messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Levothyroxine is a man-made form of thyroxine (T4), one of the hormones your thyroid gland normally produces.
It belongs to a class of medications called hormones.
It works by replacing thyroid hormone that your body is not making enough of.
Levothyroxine is used in adults and children, including newborn babies, to:
treat hypothyroidism (underactive thyroid - a condition where the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormone).
It replaces the missing hormone whether the condition was present from birth or developed later.
It replaces the missing hormone whether the problem starts in the thyroid gland itself or in the pituitary gland or hypothalamus.
lower the level of thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH) in the blood in people being treated for a certain type of thyroid cancer, alongside surgery and radioactive iodine therapy.
Levothyroxine injection is used in adults to treat myxedema coma.
Myxedema coma is a rare and life-threatening complication.
Myxedema coma is a complication of a severely underactive thyroid.
Without thyroid hormone, your body cannot function properly.
Triplet: ["Thyroid hormone", "required for", "body to function properly"]

The relation 'required for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject substance is necessary for the function or process described in the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has function': The subject entity performs the function or role specified by the object entity.
B. 'contribute to': The subject entity plays a role in or contributes to the development or occurrence of the object entity, which is typically a physiological or pathological process.
C. 'metabolized by': The subject entity is metabolized by the enzyme or process specified by the object entity.
D. 'has rules on': The subject drug is subject to the rules specified by the object entity.
E. 'is defined as': The subject condition or entity is defined by the description specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
